summary.plain: The PEP-4 time projection chamber: a gas-filled cylinder two metres long that records the ionisation trails of charged particles as three-dimensional images and identifies them by how much energy they lose.
summary.technical: PEP-4 TPC: 2 m long cylindrical drift volume (40 cm inner, 2 m outer diameter), 80% argon / 20% methane gas at 8.5 atm, central cathode membrane at -75 kV, six end-cap sectors with multiwire proportional chambers, solenoidal field.
